title: Two tracks, one foundation
caption: Enablement and Agentic Engineering differ in tools and audience, not in method.

enablement.label: Track 1
enablement.name: AI Enablement
enablement.body: Everyone who works with documents, mail and meetings gets an AI assistant into daily work.

engineering.label: Track 2
engineering.name: Agentic Engineering
engineering.body: Teams that build software let agents write, check and ship code inside a governed repo.

foundation.label: Shared foundation
foundation.body: Attention, onboarding, specs, skills and workflows: the same methods in both tracks

talking-points.description: Today you saw the foundation. Enablement is for everyone; Agentic Engineering is for teams that build software. Neither is the advanced version of the other: same methods, different tools.
